spellbook.finance/limitations: The link expires, and expiresAt says when. Fetch it fresh at the moment you hand it over instead of reusing an older one.
The seller signs in at eBay, not here. No password, API key or token passes through you in either direction, and there is nothing for you to store.
Only the seller opens the returned eBay consent link. After consent, verify the result with spellbook_ebay_connection_status instead of opening a SpellBook page.
ManaPool uses spellbook_manapool_connect_link because its seller API uses a key the seller pastes into SpellBook themselves. CardTrader still connects on the account settings page.
TCGplayer has no connect link. Its sync runs through a paired browser extension. Call spellbook_tcg_extension_pairing for the pairing state and the page the seller pairs on.

description: Get a one-click link the seller opens to connect their eBay account to SpellBook Finance. Call spellbook_ebay_connection_status first. The link is signed for this customer and expires, so fetch a fresh one when you hand it over. Give them the link and tell them eBay will ask them to sign in and approve the connection. Once they finish, call spellbook_ebay_connection_status again; the agent never needs to open a SpellBook browser.
name: spellbook_ebay_connect_link
